command.name: Bloodscale Terror
verbatim: Odd-numbered Rounds: 20% chance to afflict Stun on 1 Enemy in any lane for 2 round(s).
Rounds 2, 5, 8: Deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy in any lane (Damage Rate: +140%).

At 10 Stars: Round 1: The chance to Stun is increased to 40%. Even-numbered Rounds: 50% chance to reduce Instinct and Initiative by -12% (enhanced by Intelligence) of 1 Enemy in any lane for 2 round(s).

vanguard.name: Hunter's Cunning
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Recovery Received by +20% and Intelligence by +25. Increase Physical Damage Dealt by +10% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Enervate
habits.verbatim: At the start of combat, reduce Tactical Damage Dealt by -13% of 1 Enemy that deals Tactical Damage until the end of combat.

habits.name: Dragon's Intellect
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Damage Received by -6% and increase your Intelligence by +12% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Bloodscale Fury
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 18% chance to afflict Weakened (-20%) on 1 Enemy in any lane (prioritize targets NOT afflicted with Stun) for 2 round(s). This chance is doubled (35%) against targets afflicted with Taunt.

habits.name: Unlikely Hero
habits.verbatim: Start of Each Round: Increase Physical Damage Received (excluding Basic Attacks) and Fire Damage Received by +10% for all Enemies above 75% max troop capacity until the end of the round. Start of Each Round: Reduce Recovery Received by -20% for all Enemies below 25% max troop capacity until the end of the round.

habits.name: Vermin's Bane
habits.verbatim: Bloodscale Terror gains: Even-numbered Rounds: 50% chance to reduce Instinct and Initiative by -12% (enhanced by Intelligence) of the enemy with the highest Instinct for 2 round(s). Round 1: The chance to Stun is increased to 40%.
